name: @pipeworx/mcp-sistat-si

tools.name: subjects
tools.description: Navigate the SiStat table tree. Nodes are folders (type "l") or tables (type "t", id ends in ".px"). Root lists tables directly.

tools.name: table_meta
tools.description: Table definition (dimensions, valid values). Path is the .px table id, e.g. "0156101S.px".

tools.name: query_table
tools.description: Pull data from a table (max 50,000,000 cells). path is the .px table id; body is a PxWeb query object.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-sistat-si forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the sistat-si pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
